_meta.label: EXAMPLE DATA — Harbor Labs fictional cohort for demo only
_meta.note: All names, comments and review notes are invented. No real employee data. Not Consensys/Deel/Maersk.

signals.text: I trust Elena's judgment, but decisions take weeks to land. We need clearer ownership on roadmap calls.
Manager note: Maya delivers solid PRDs. Stretch: influence without waiting for perfect consensus.
Promoted peers got visibility I didn't. Not bitter — just unclear what 'ready for senior' means here.
On-call plus three concurrent migrations is unsustainable. I've cancelled PTO twice this quarter.
Jordan is the glue for our services, but he's visibly exhausted. We lean on him too hard.
If nothing changes on staffing, I'll start looking. I like the team — I can't keep this pace.
Design system docs are excellent. Pairing with Kenji made me feel part of the crew from week one.
Luca ships clean UI and asks great questions. Ready for more ownership on accessibility.
Remote standups still cut me off mid-sentence sometimes. Small thing, but it adds up.
People priorities shift every sprint. Hard to know if we're measuring the right org outcomes.
Aisha ran a thoughtful listening tour. Recognition: she surfaced three manager coaching themes leadership missed.
I feel heard by Samir. Still waiting on budget for the manager toolkit we proposed.
Quota jumped 30% with no enablement on the new packaging. Demos feel improvised.
Noah closes well when he has collateral. Without it he burns cycles reinventing decks.
Hit 112% last quarter — got a Slack emoji. Competitors are recruiting with real equity stories.
Critique culture here is kind and sharp. Best design team I've been on.
Sofia elevated our research cadence. Promote to senior when headcount opens.
I'd love a path into product strategy, not only visual craft. Mentorship with Elena helps.
CI is flaky three days a week. Engineers waste hours babysitting pipelines.
Kenji improved API latency meaningfully. Blocker: platform investment keeps slipping.
Priya advocates for us. Leadership still underfunds developer experience.
Hiring bar is inconsistent across teams. Candidates notice.
Amélie professionalized our interview loops. Strong operator; keep her close to exec planning.
Excited about the employer brand work. Need exec sponsorship so it isn't a side project.
LATAM pipeline targets ignore local buying cycles. Feels set in HQ without us.
Diego coaches his team well under pressure. Risk: he's covering two vacant AE seats.
Burning out covering gaps. Told Claire I need backfill by month-end or I'll step down from IC work.
I'm doing the same dashboard refreshes for a year. Learning curve flatlined.
Priya is reliable. Stretch assignment into experimentation design would unlock her.
Asked twice about a stretch project. Still waiting. Starting to feel invisible.
Incident retros are excellent. I feel trusted with production.
Owen stabilized paging noise. Quiet high performer — make sure recognition isn't only for loud shippers.
Timezone makes social channels hard. Belonging is work-focused, which is fine if intentional.
Managers want coaching but won't protect calendar time for it. Programs stall.
Fatima's manager academy NPS is outstanding. Recommend expanding budget.
Proud of what we built. Frustrated that completion rates drop when OKRs get noisy.
SE ↔ AE handoffs improved a lot this half. Finally feel like one GTM team.
Theo is patient with complex RFPs. Customers trust him.
Would appreciate clearer path from SE to principal. Criteria are fuzzy.
I'm managing 11 directs after the reorg. 1:1s are theatres, not coaching.
Yuki holds standards high. Needs a tech lead hire or span of control will break her.
Told Priya I'm at capacity. If we hire another EM I stay; otherwise I'll protect my health.
CS wins rarely get all-hands airtime. Feels like only closed-won AEs get celebrated.
Camila saved two renewals this quarter. Quiet hero — spotlight her.
Claire started a wins channel. Mood improved. Still want career ladder clarity.
Product ops work is respected. Cross-team rituals finally stick.
Ibrahim is the operating system for launches. High trust.
Slight concern: strategy docs change mid-quarter without a clear changelog.
